returns.summary: Our policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have gone by since your purchase, we can't offer a refund or exchange. Items must be unworn and in the same condition you received them, in the original packaging.

_rewards: PLACES+FACES has no loyalty programme. The template's Account rewards card is kept as an illustrative app concept (same as the yelir reference build) and its fine print says so; it never claims a real scheme.
_discount: The site's pop-up ('JOIN THE PLACES+FACES COMMUNITY') offers no discount. The app shows the template's first-app-order concept offer with a placeholder code (APP10).

copy.about: PLACES+FACES began in 2013 when Ciesay spent his summer in New York City, talking his way into hip hop shows and photographing artists in their prime element, while Soulz was back in London photographing the culture, concerts and artists there. What started as two friends documenting the world around them became something much bigger.
